description: Prometne mreže - WMS INSPIRE (anonimni korisnici) is a dataset listed in NIPP Geoportal Croatia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoportal.dgu.hr. Transport Networks – WMS INSPIRE (anonymous users) is a web viewing service that enables the visualisation of harmonised spatial data in accordance with the INSPIRE theme ‘Transport Networks’. The service is available through the WMS standard and is intended for public access without authentication. Coverage: HR. The portal shows the English title as "Transport networks - WMS INSPIRE (anonymous users)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include inspiregeoportal, Prometne mreže, TTB, topografija, topološki podaci. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nipp.
